title: Application form answers and final submission
context: 12-question form per the buildathon page. The 'what broke, and how you got out' answer is read first — use a real story from T6.2 or T7.1, not a generic one.
objective: Draft all 12 answers, review, and submit before the Sept 5 deadline.
scope_in: Full name, college, graduation year, in-person availability, 6/12 month choice, resume, track (Track 01), project name, what it solves, public GitHub URL, unlisted pitch video URL, what broke story
No fabricated metrics or claims anywhere in the answers
acceptance_criteria: All 12 fields completed with specific, verifiable answers
'What broke' answer references a real, specific incident from the build (e.g. an actual bug hit in T6.2 or T7.1)
Form submitted, confirmation received, before Sept 5 deadline
